title: Dress up 18 pretty holes the day before, then revert
expect_summary: Sustained score is the lower of the current score and the median of the last 8 checkpoints (missing checkpoints count as 0). The gamed course gets prestige below the honest course; editing holes after applying cancels the application.

checks.text: gamed sustained equals its median not its spike
honest prestige exceeds gamed prestige by 60 or more
